out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at MAIN SERVICE COOKLINE being used to wash a pot. Observed the handsink at the BROTH RANGE used to store containers.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Containers removed from broth range handsink. EHS discussed with PIC to have equipment washed and sanitized in the 3 compartment sink.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed raw shell eggs stored over vegetables in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Employee to rearrange food items to have eggs on bottom shelving.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution. Dish machine tested at 0ppm, after discussing with PIC that dish machine is not in working order EHS observed employee load and run dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. Equipment placed in sanitizer basin of 3 vat sink after dish machine cycle.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility. Cockroach bait applicator with bait observed on top of the dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC agreed to return roach bait applicator to pest control provider.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sink at cookline or kitchen entry.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. Paper towels placed at handsinks.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Raw shell eggs observed stored over RTE foods in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Employee moved eggs to bottom shelf.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: vegetable chopper in prep area observed with food debris, PIC stated chopper was not used today.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. Beef in walk in cooler observed at 64F after 6hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. Beef discarded. EHS discussed cooling methods with PIC.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: Observed cooked beef cooling in walk in cooler covered in plastic wrap.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. Do not cover food items until they are cooled. YI'S TRADITIONAL KOREAN BEEF SOUP (Inspection Date: 03/23/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: observed raw beef defrosting in sink basin of ambient water, observed raw ground pork packages defrosting in ambient.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. Water turned on to run on beef, pork moved to a prep sink basin to have water run on it.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed kimchi being prepared on the floor, observed food items stored on the floor of the walk in cooler, observed tripe which was about to be cooked stored on the floor near the cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Please ensure that all food items are stored above the floor.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: cardboard observed lining the shelving units in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. Please remove or change cardboard at a frequency it does not build debris.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. Open drink containers observed in food preparation areas.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. PIC moved employee drink containers.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: broth on range observed at 75F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Induction under broth turned on to reheat. Discussed the danger zone temperatures with PIC.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked tendon (45F) observed in 2 Dr prep at cookline. Sliced beef (50F) and cooked cucumber (47F) observed in 1 Dr UR display.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Items to be discarded

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed spray container with blue liquid in kitchen area. PIC stated it is table cleaner.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. Sanitizer labeled. YI'S TRADITIONAL KOREAN BEEF SOUP (Inspection Date: 09/08/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: rice scoops observed in container of ambient water. Scoop for broth at cookline observed stored touching cardboard.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Utensils taken to wash rinse and sanitize

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: CARDBOARD observed lining all storage shelving in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EHS discussed that cardboard must be changed when discolored or deteriorating.
